title: Water main works — Vista Street
message: Sydney Water will be carrying out planned maintenance on Vista Street from 9am–3pm. Expect brief water interruptions for nearby properties.

title: New bin collection day from August
message: Council has confirmed general waste collection is moving from Tuesdays to Thursdays starting 3 August. Recycling and green waste days are unchanged.

title: Community Facebook group reaches 1,000 members
message: Thanks to everyone who's joined the Akuna Vista community group — a great milestone for a growing neighbourhood.

title: Park playground equipment temporarily closed
message: The playground at Akuna Vista Park is closed for scheduled safety inspections and expected to reopen within the week.

title: New street library on Ridgeline Drive
message: A neighbour has set up a street library out the front of 24 Ridgeline Drive — take a book, leave a book.
